query:
UPDATE card
                SET image_source   = CASE WHEN language_code = $1 THEN $2 ELSE $3 END,
                    image_has_back = $4
                WHERE set_code = $5 AND collector_number = $6
                  AND (language_code = $7
                       OR (image_source IS NOT NULL
                           AND (language_code = $1 OR image_source <> $8)));
